title: Big Teams: Share Your Strategies for Agentic Coding

s1.description: Opening: what this session is, how the drop-in levels work, and house rules.

s2.description: Level 1: a live poll about the room and its tools, then an open mic.

s3.description: Level 2: birds-of-a-feather tables on six big-team problems, with report-outs.

s4.description: Level 3: Two wins and a regret, a decisions game.

s5.description: Wrap: read the strategy wall and share the write-up.
